episode.episode_title: The Power Cut: Why Microsoft Just Walked Away from Essex
episode.episode_description: Microsoft has cancelled its plans for a major AI data centre in Loughton, Essex, after learning the site won't have enough electricity until the 2030s. We look at what this means for the UK's AI ambitions.
episode.selection_reason: The lead verified story from today's Sapiver Forge Daily Brief.

selected_story.headline: Microsoft pulls plug on Essex AI data centre deal
selected_story.source_title: Microsoft cancels its deal with Nscale to serve as the anchor tenant and rent 23K Nvidia AI chips at a planned data center facing repeated delays in Essex, UK (James Titcomb/Telegraph)

short.title: Microsoft pulls plug on Essex AI data centre deal
short.description:
It highlights the physical limits of the AI boom; even with capital and demand, the UK's grid infrastructure is struggling to keep pace with the power requirements of high-density GPU clusters.
